title: Open-Set Domain Adaptation Under Background Distribution Shift: Challenges and A Provably Efficient Solution
abstract: arXiv:2512.01152v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: As we deploy machine learning systems in the real world, a core challenge is to maintain a model that is performant even as the data shifts. Such shifts can take many forms: new classes may emerge that were absent during training, a problem known as open-set recognition, and the distribution of known categories may change. Guarantees on open-set recognition are mostly derived under the assumption that the distribution of known classes, which we call the background distribution, is fixed. In this paper we develop CoLOR, a method that is guaranteed to solve open-set recognition even in the challenging case where the background distribution shifts. We prove that the method works under benign assumptions that the novel class is separable from the non-novel classes, and provide theoretical guarantees that it outperforms a representative baseline in a simplified overparameterized setting. We develop techniques to make CoLOR scalable

translated_title: 背景分布偏移下的开集域自适应：挑战与一种可证明高效的解决方案
translated_abstract: 随着我们将机器学习系统部署到现实世界中，一个核心挑战是即使在数据发生偏移时也能保持模型的性能。这种偏移可以有多种形式：可能出现训练期间不存在的新类别，这被称为开集识别问题；同时已知类别的分布也可能发生变化。关于开集识别的保证大多是在已知类别的分布（我们称之为背景分布）固定不变的假设下推导出来的。在本文中，我们开发了CoLOR，一种即使在背景分布发生偏移这一具有挑战性的情况下也能保证解决开集识别问题的方法。我们证明了该方法在良性假设下有效，即新类别与非新类别是可分离的，并在简化的过参数化设置中提供了理论保证，证明其优于代表性基线方法。我们还开发了使CoLOR具备可扩展性的技术。
tldr: 本文提出CoLOR方法，首次在背景分布发生偏移的挑战性条件下为开集识别提供可证明的理论保证，证明其在新类别可分离的良性假设下优于代表性基线方法并具备可扩展性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CoLOR, a provably efficient method that solves open-set recognition even under background distribution shift, with theoretical guarantees of outperforming representative baselines under benign separability assumptions and scalable techniques for practical deployment.
